hook_line: INDIA'S EB-2 GREEN CARD LINE STAYS FROZEN IN 2013

hook_stat.sub: Projected wait for an Indian national filing in EB-2 in January 2026 or later

stats.label: India's EB-2 final action date, unchanged for a second straight month
EB-2 final action date for most other countries, after advancing three months
Indians waiting in the first three employment-based preferences, about 79% of the total

diaspora_bullets: A green card can only be approved if your priority date is before November 1, 2013
Indian EB-2 applicants with priority dates before January 15, 2015 can file adjustment applications for November
news_summary: The November 2026 Visa Bulletin keeps India's EB-2 final action date at November 1, 2013, unchanged for a second straight month, while most other countries advanced three months to April 1, 2025.
payoff: India's EB-2 line did not move, while a USCIS proposal to amend premium processing timeframes sits under White House review with its text still not public.
